gameplay.address_lookup: Every property and building resolves to one canonical street address.
gameplay.dispatch: Every building access point has a constructed in-game route to a named road or a private access lane.
gameplay.investigation: Property, building, premises, unit, address, access point and route IDs are stable and cross-linked.
gameplay.occupancy: Units are deliberately unassigned; population allocation is a separate population operation and no residents are created by this dataset.
gameplay.patrol: Vehicle-capable access routes are explicitly identified; pedestrian routes remain separately typed.
gameplay.population_cap: No population records are created; the 10,000-person city cap is unaffected.

limitations: All content is fictional Saltwater game canon.
No real-world property, title, legal access, survey or construction claims are made.
No residents, businesses, tenants or police personnel are created by this dataset.
The source parcel geometry and building footprints are deterministic game design geometry.
